```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 15_related_anova_calculate_f
title: >
  Calculate the F-ratio
questions:
  - id: related_anova_f
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      If $MS_{between\ treatments} = 140.4$ and $MS_{error} = 3.0$, what is F?
    answer: 46.8
    tolerance: 0.1
    explanation: >
      $F = MS_{between\ treatments} / MS_{error} = 140.4 / 3.0 = 46.8$.
```
